description: Defines functions, structures, and enums related to calculating MCS and TBS for PDSCH and PUSCH in 5G NR scheduling, including error handling and rate validation.

classes.name: sch_mcs_tbs
classes.description: Container for MCS and TBS results, used to specify modulation and transport block size.

classes.name: compute_ul_mcs_tbs_error
classes.description: Enumeration of possible errors during uplink MCS and TBS computation.

methods.name: compute_dl_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the downlink MCS and TBS ensuring the code rate does not exceed 0.95.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts compute_ul_mcs_tbs_error enum values to descriptive strings.

methods.name: compute_ul_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates uplink MCS and TBS with validation, returning either the result or an error.

methods.name: compute_ul_tbs
methods.description: Determines the uplink TBS based on MCS and PRBs, validating code rate.

methods.name: compute_ul_tbs_unsafe
methods.description: Calculates TBS without validation of code rate.

methods.name: is_pusch_effective_rate_valid
methods.description: Checks if the selected MCS, TBS, and PRBs result in a valid effective code rate and UCI.
